summary: The Mercado Libre Reputation System Evolution modernizes seller and buyer trust mechanisms through AI-powered workflows across multiple countries. The new system automates reputation processes, reduces fraud, and significantly improves the buyer experience when discovering new sellers and items.

challenge.title: Migrating legacy reputation systems across multiple countries while introducing AI-driven automation to reduce manual processes and improve trust.
challenge.description: Mercado Libre's reputation system was showing its age. Legacy implementations varied across countries, creating inconsistent seller experiences and making manual trust evaluation a bottleneck. The challenge was three-fold: migrate sellers and their historical reputation data from the old system without disruption, standardize reputation logic across countries with different regulatory and market requirements, and introduce AI workflows to dramatically reduce manual intervention. All of this required careful planning, phased rollouts, and close coordination with sellers and marketplace trust teams.

solution.title: Engineering a next-generation reputation system with AI workflows that accelerated country rollout and significantly increased seller program adoption and company revenue.
solution.description: I led the reputation team through a comprehensive modernization effort. We architected a new reputation system built on machine learning foundations, capable of analyzing transaction patterns, user behavior, and market signals to automatically assess seller trustworthiness. We created a phased migration plan that reduced risk—moving countries in waves, continuously validating that AI decisions matched or exceeded human judgment. The new system integrates sophisticated AI workflows that automate reputation scoring, fraud detection, and trust assessment. For buyers, this meant discovering new sellers with confidence. For sellers, it meant fair, transparent reputation mechanics that reward good behavior. The results were exceptional: significantly accelerated program takeoff in each country as sellers gained confidence in the system, and direct revenue impact through reduced fraud and increased transaction volumes. The reputation system is now a strategic asset that enhances trust across the entire Mercado Libre ecosystem.

images.alt: Mercado Libre Reputation - AI-powered Trust System

summary: The Mercado Libre Sales Platform Integration project unifies the Mercado Pago and Mercado Libre ecosystems into a single, cohesive seller experience. Sellers can now view all transaction data, sales metrics, and payment information across both platforms in one consolidated dashboard.

challenge.title: Integrating two distinct platforms—Mercado Pago and Mercado Libre—into a unified seller experience that consolidates all sales and payment data.
challenge.description: Sellers faced a fragmented experience, forced to toggle between Mercado Pago for payment data and Mercado Libre for sales data. Building a single source of truth required deep coordination with multiple teams across different codebases and architectures. The technical challenge was immense: reconciling different data models, handling eventual consistency across systems, managing billions of transactions, and ensuring sub-second response times across geographies. More importantly, it required organizational alignment—convincing teams to collaborate on shared infrastructure despite working on separate product milestones.

solution.title: Leading the architectural effort to integrate both platforms through a unified codebase and cross-team collaboration, enabling sellers to see all sales and payments in one place.
solution.description: As a senior engineer on the sales team, I led the initiative to create a shared repository and unified API layer that seamlessly accessed data from both Mercado Pago and Mercado Libre. Rather than attempting a full merge of codebases, we architected a sophisticated integration layer that provided a single view of customer data while respecting each platform's autonomy. This required working closely with engineering teams across both products, aligning on data contracts and establishing shared development practices. We implemented intelligent caching strategies to handle the massive transaction volumes without impacting performance. The result transformed the seller experience—they no longer bounce between apps. Today, sellers can view all their Mercado Pago transactions and Mercado Libre sales in both applications. This integration increased seller engagement significantly and became a core competitive advantage for the Mercado Libre ecosystem.

images.alt: Mercado Libre Sales - Unified Seller Dashboard

summary: Miguel Bogota Dev V3 is the latest iteration of the personal portfolio, leveraging TanStack Start for cutting-edge fullstack framework capabilities. Deployed on Firebase App Hosting, the portfolio consumes data from the Miguel Bogota Dev API, representing the evolution toward modern, composable web architecture.

challenge.title: Exploring next-generation fullstack frameworks that blur the lines between client and server while maintaining a unified development experience.
challenge.description: As the web platform evolved, new frameworks emerged offering unprecedented developer experience through better abstraction of client-server boundaries. The challenge was evaluating TanStack Start as a next-generation fullstack framework—understanding its server function capabilities, file-based routing, and how to effectively structure a portfolio application using these new paradigms. This required rethinking architectural patterns and embracing a more integrated approach to fullstack development.

solution.title: Architecting a modern portfolio with TanStack Start and Firebase App Hosting, demonstrating cutting-edge fullstack development patterns.
solution.description: V3 represents the current evolution of the portfolio, built with TanStack Start to explore modern fullstack framework capabilities. Server functions handle backend logic seamlessly, enabling isomorphic code that runs on both client and server as appropriate. The application continues to integrate with the Miguel Bogota Dev API for data management, maintaining the separation of concerns established in v2. Firebase App Hosting provides a modern deployment platform optimized for fullstack applications. TypeScript throughout ensures type safety across the entire application. This version serves as both a functional portfolio and an experimental ground for evaluating emerging web technologies. The progression from v1 to v3 demonstrates the rapid evolution of web development tools and the importance of staying current with modern practices.

images.alt: Miguel Bogota Dev V3 - Fullstack Modern Portfolio

summary: Miguel Bogota Dev V2 is the second iteration of the personal portfolio, built with Next.js for improved performance and server-side rendering capabilities. The portfolio integrates with the Miguel Bogota Dev API to fetch project and experience data, creating a dynamic, data-driven experience with modern fullstack architecture.

challenge.title: Modernizing the portfolio architecture with server-side rendering while establishing a clean separation between data management and presentation layers.
challenge.description: Version 1 worked well, but modern web standards demanded better performance, SEO, and scalability. The challenge was migrating from a purely client-side Angular app to a Next.js fullstack architecture that leveraged server-side rendering for superior performance. Additionally, integrating with the newly created Miguel Bogota Dev API meant establishing reliable client-server communication patterns and handling data fetching efficiently.

solution.title: Building a modernized portfolio with Next.js, Firebase Cloud Functions, and API integration for superior performance and data management.
solution.description: I rebuilt the portfolio with Next.js to unlock server-side rendering benefits and improved performance metrics. The application consumes data from the Miguel Bogota Dev API, creating a clean separation between content management and presentation. Firebase Hosting provides the frontend infrastructure, while Cloud Functions handle serverless backend operations. This architecture enables dynamic content updates without redeploying the entire application. TypeScript enforces type safety throughout the stack. The experience demonstrated the power of modern fullstack frameworks and the importance of scalable data architectures. V2 served as a bridge between v1's foundation and the modern frameworks that would follow.

summary: Crypto June is a cross-platform mobile application that enables users to monitor cryptocurrency prices and portfolio performance in real-time. Built entirely with React Native and Expo, the app delivers a native-quality experience on both iOS and Android, providing investors with instant access to their digital asset tracking.

challenge.title: Engineering a performant cryptocurrency tracking app that delivers real-time price updates across iOS and Android while maintaining smooth UI performance.
challenge.description: Building a cryptocurrency price tracker required solving multiple technical challenges simultaneously. The app needed to fetch real-time data from external APIs, display updates instantly without draining battery or bandwidth, and maintain a smooth, responsive interface across different device capabilities. As the sole developer, I also needed to master both iOS and Android deployment while ensuring the codebase remained maintainable for future enhancements.

solution.title: Architecting a cross-platform mobile app using React Native and Expo to deliver native performance with shared code across iOS and Android platforms.
solution.description: I built Crypto June as a complete learning project in mobile development, leveraging React Native and Expo to maximize code reuse while delivering native performance on both iOS and Android. The app integrates with the CoinGecko API for real-time cryptocurrency data, using SWR for intelligent caching and efficient data fetching. Redux and Redux Toolkit manage complex application state around user portfolios and price alerts. The UI layer uses RNUILib for a polished, native-feeling experience with smooth animations. By enforcing code quality with TypeScript, ESLint, and Prettier throughout development, I ensured the codebase remained professional and maintainable. The result demonstrates the feasibility of building production-quality fintech applications with React Native.

images.alt: Crypto June - Real-time Price Updates Animation

summary: On Watch Us is a critical maritime navigation platform that enables pilots to guide vessels safely through complex port operations in Galveston, Texas. The platform streamlines communication between maritime professionals and port authorities, reducing coordination time and enhancing safety protocols.

challenge.title: Building a safety-critical maritime application that seamlessly integrates mobile functionality with a robust backend while prioritizing real-time communication and reliability.
challenge.description: Maritime operations demand precision, speed, and reliability that cannot tolerate failure. The challenge was architecting a system where pilots could communicate vessel guidance information with port authorities instantaneously, across diverse devices and network conditions. This required not just elegant code, but systems thinking—understanding how cross-platform mobile applications and backend services must integrate to support mission-critical operations where mistakes can have serious consequences.

solution.title: Leading the development of a comprehensive maritime coordination platform using Flutter for cross-platform mobile delivery and Node.js, Conduit for a scalable backend.
solution.description: As lead senior developer, I architected both the mobile and backend layers of On Watch Us. Flutter provided the foundation for delivering a responsive, native-feeling mobile experience across platforms—critical for pilots working in dynamic port environments. On the backend, I implemented a Node.js service using the Conduit framework, creating a scalable, maintainable infrastructure designed for real-time data exchange. By applying object-oriented programming principles, I ensured the codebase remained maintainable and extensible. The result was a platform that successfully simplified port communication workflows in Galveston, enabling safer and faster vessel guidance operations.

images.alt: On Watch Us - Maritime Navigation Platform

summary: Galtex is an enterprise order management platform redesigned for security, efficiency, and performance. As a critical internal application at Newton Vision Corporation, the platform serves as the backbone for order processing operations with a focus on user accessibility and system reliability.

challenge.title: Modernizing a legacy order management system while leading a team to achieve measurable improvements in security, accessibility, and performance.
challenge.description: The original order management system had become a bottleneck for operations. It lacked modern security standards, failed to meet accessibility requirements, and struggled under performance demands. As a senior developer and quality analyst, I faced the challenge of not just rebuilding the platform, but doing so while mentoring a team through a complete architectural overhaul. This required technical expertise, strategic thinking, and leadership to drive consensus and maintain quality standards throughout the transformation.

solution.title: Leading the development of a modernized cross-platform order management system achieving 33% performance improvement and accessibility compliance.
solution.description: I led the Galtex modernization initiative, architecting a new solution built with TypeScript, React for web, and React Native for mobile—enabling employees to access order management from any device. I implemented Redux and Redux Sagas for predictable state management and complex async workflows. The team enforced strict code quality standards with ESLint and Prettier from day one. Through careful optimization and performance profiling, we achieved a 33% performance improvement while simultaneously implementing comprehensive accessibility features. The security-first approach included encrypted communications, role-based access controls, and audit logging. The result transformed Galtex from a legacy system into a modern, performant platform that enabled employees to work more efficiently while maintaining enterprise-grade security and accessibility standards.

summary: Clothing park is a personal project which help me to improve technologies like React, Redux, Firebase and good practices. With an effort to keep my skill sharp I took the initiative to create something different and new while improving some of my low areas.

challenge.title: Mastering advanced state management patterns while building a production-grade application without prior hands-on experience.
challenge.description: Learning React fundamentals was just the beginning. The real challenge emerged when tackling Redux architecture, Redux Sagas for side effects, and integrating third-party services like Stripe for payment processing. Managing complex application state across multiple components, handling asynchronous operations, and maintaining code quality standards felt overwhelming. I needed a practical project to bridge theory and implementation.

solution.title: Building a complete e-commerce platform from concept to deployment, using it as a learning laboratory for advanced React patterns and full-stack development.
solution.description: I created Clothing Park as a deliberate learning exercise. By implementing Redux for centralized state management and Redux Sagas for complex async workflows, I gained hands-on experience with industry-standard patterns. The full-stack development—React frontend, Node.js backend, PostgreSQL database, and Stripe integration—forced me to understand not just individual tools, but how they work together. Enforcing TypeScript, ESLint, and Prettier from the start ensured I built professional coding habits early. The result was a production-ready application that transformed theoretical knowledge into practical expertise.

summary: NVC Movies is a comprehensive movie discovery and curation platform that aggregates detailed film information and enables users to discover, explore, and rank movies based on personalized preferences. The platform combines rich data visualization with an intuitive rating system.

challenge.title: Building a scalable movie discovery platform that aggregates diverse data sources while providing an engaging user experience for browsing and ranking films.
challenge.description: Creating a movie application meant interfacing with external APIs, handling large datasets efficiently, and designing an interface that makes sense of hundreds of films. The challenge involved architecting a frontend that could gracefully handle data loading, searching, filtering, and maintaining user rankings without becoming cluttered or overwhelming. This was an opportunity to strengthen full-stack fundamentals while exploring Angular's capabilities for complex data manipulation.

solution.title: Developing a full-stack movie platform with Angular for dynamic front-end interactivity and Firebase for serverless backend support.
solution.description: NVC Movies was architected with Angular to leverage its powerful data binding and component architecture for creating responsive interfaces. I integrated movie database APIs to populate rich film information—titles, descriptions, ratings, and imagery. The application features a custom ranking system that allows users to create personalized movie lists, with all data persisting through Firebase. Code quality was maintained throughout with ESLint and Prettier enforcing consistent standards. The result is a polished application that demonstrates end-to-end full-stack development capabilities, from API integration to user interface design.
